title: Israeli Attack Kills Al-Masri Family of Six in Gaza City's Sabra Neighborhood
detail: An Israeli air strike hit the al-Masri family home in the Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City on Tuesday as the family slept, killing Firas and Salsabeel al-Masri and their four children. Rescue workers battled flames engulfing the house before recovering the bodies. The Israeli military confirmed the strike, saying its target was a Hamas militant and that it was still assessing the results of the attack. Separately the same day, an Israeli strike killed 3 Palestinians at a shelter near Al-Yemen Al-Saeed Hospital in northern Gaza, and an Israeli drone strike killed 3 more near the British Hospital southwest of Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis. The deaths added to a post-ceasefire toll that had by then surpassed 1,150 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 truce.

media.caption: Mourners grieve beside a body following an Israeli strike on the al-Masri family home in Gaza City's Sabra neighborhood — July 21, 2026
